## Summary

## Type of change

- [ ] Feature (new shell component/behavior)
- [ ] Fix
- [ ] Refactor / code quality (no behavior change)
- [ ] CI / tooling / docs
- [ ] Release (version bump and CHANGELOG only)

## Target branch

- [ ] `dev` (normal work)
- [ ] `test` (release candidate: `dev -> test`, version bumped)
- [ ] `main` (release: `test -> main`, all checks green on `test`)

## Checklist

- [ ] `make check` passes locally
- [ ] New behavior is covered by tests under `tests/`
- [ ] `PRD.md` updated if scope or components changed
- [ ] No secrets, generated files, or build output committed
- [ ] No direct edits to `VERSION` unless this is a release PR
- [ ] Documentation updated where behavior is user-visible
